propositions: Test `test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count` fails intermittently under xdist (`-n 3 --dist worksteal`) and passes in isolation because INFO-level log record is dropped at originating `rebar_reconciler` logger before caplog handler sees it.

Logger level on shared root `rebar_reconciler` is set to WARNING by `__main__.py:606` call to `install_stderr_handler` and is never restored, leaking from the first test that drives the reconciler entrypoint in-process to all subsequent tests in the same xdist worker.
Existing caplog containment guard in `tests/conftest.py` only covers the single `rebar` root logger and misses the sibling `rebar_reconciler` root, leaving INFO assertions unprotected.

Fix generalizes the guard from single root to tuple of shared roots (`rebar`, `rebar_reconciler`), making all four primitives in `tests/_log_integrity.py` operate over the full set and restore level for each.

The missing summary line is not caused by the storeless (`confirm_store is None`) path, as evidenced by the captured records containing the per-item decline line which only fires when store is non-None.
